posts.title: Fused Linear Cross-Entropy
posts.description: Why fusing the LM head projection with cross-entropy is the single biggest memory win for training LLMs at long context.

papers.title: Trillion 7B Technical Report
papers.description: A token-efficient Korean-centric multilingual 7B model that achieves competitive results with 10% of its 2T training tokens dedicated to multilingual data.

papers.title: LLM-as-an-Interviewer: Beyond Static Testing Through Dynamic LLM Evaluation
papers.description: A multi-turn evaluation paradigm where the LLM interviewer issues follow-up questions and feedback to the model under test.

papers.title: Evaluating Language Models as Synthetic Data Generators
papers.description: AgoraBench compares language models as synthetic data generators across instance generation, response generation, and quality enhancement.

papers.title: MM-Eval: A Multilingual Meta-Evaluation Benchmark for LLM-as-a-Judge and Reward Models
papers.description: A meta-evaluation suite spanning 18 languages and 6 subsets that stress-tests judge and reward models on non-English outputs.

papers.title: The BiGGen Bench: A Principled Benchmark for Fine-grained Evaluation of Language Models with Language Models
papers.description: A 765-instance benchmark covering nine capabilities with instance-specific rubrics, evaluated by language model judges.

papers.title: Prometheus 2: An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating Other Language Models
papers.description: An open evaluator LM trained by merging direct-assessment and pairwise-ranking experts, narrowing the gap to GPT-4 on judge benchmarks.

papers.title: CLIcK: A Benchmark Dataset of Cultural and Linguistic Intelligence in Korean
papers.description: 1,995 Korean-native QA items spanning culture and linguistics for benchmarking Korean cultural and linguistic competence in LLMs.
